entries.zh: 丑陋可耻；卑贱下流（ruín、bajo、vil 三词并列，谓品格卑劣）
entries.en: ugly, shameful; base, low, vile (ruín, bajo, vil)

entries.zh: 软弱怯懦（软脚）；低微无足轻重
entries.en: weak, spineless; of little importance, insignificant

entries.zh: 卑贱低劣之人、下等人（头词首字残缺，据西语短语与音写推断，义同「小人」）
entries.en: a base/mean man; a low person (ruín hombre, bajo)
entries.notes: H 栏首字残缺仅存「人」，释义据 L「ruín hombre, baxo」与 M 栏音写推断，故降 low。

entries.zh: 污贱：卑贱污浊、下贱无耻
下贱：出身或品行卑贱、低贱
下流人：身份低微卑贱之人
entries.en: a person of low standing; one of the lower sort
entries.notes: 「下流」按 17 世纪旧义「位卑居下」理解，非现代「下流无耻」义。

entries.zh: 〔栏首分隔行，非词条：S 部接前（ante），转入 A 部〕
entries.en: (section divider row, not a lexical entry: within S, cf. preceding — ante; transition to letter A)
entries.notes: 部首/字母分隔行，无词汇内容，与页眉检索行「R. ante. U. S, ante.」同类格式。

entries.zh: 鲢鱼（鰱魚）：白鲢，淡水鱼；西语 sábalo 本指西鲱类河鱼，此处借指
entries.en: silver carp (鰱魚); Sp. sábalo, a shad-like river fish
entries.notes: H 栏首字「鏈/鰱」两形存疑，据 M 栏音写（liēn hû）判为「鰱魚」。

entries.en: to know (saber; R column Latin note sci. = scire)

entries.zh: 能，能够；会（对应西语 saber「懂得、会做」之义）
entries.en: can, to be able; to know how (to)
to know, to recognize; to be acquainted with

entries.zh: 洞悉、明晓：透彻清楚地知道
entries.en: to know clearly/thoroughly (saber claramente); to see through
entries.notes: L 栏缩写展开（clara mte. = claramente），且 M 栏音写（tŏng chau）两音节与单字头「洞」不尽对齐，疑头词原有第二字。

entries.zh: 断绝、割断、绝（絕）；对应西语短语涂改难辨
entries.en: to sever, cut off; to break off, discontinue (Spanish phrase obscured by correction)
entries.notes: L 栏短语「Saber de correspia-」圈註涂改、语义无法定夺，释义以 H「絕」及 M 栏音写（chùat chè）为据。

entries.zh: 谙：谙熟、通晓（深知）；兼含「灵通」通达之义
entries.en: to know well, be versed in; to understand thoroughly, comprehend deeply (saber, entender, penetrar)
